title: Complete SDC Questionnaire Input
description: The form as the person's device shows it, with what was known before they saw it.

questionnaire.description: A FHIR R4 Questionnaire (https://hl7.org/fhir/R4/questionnaire.html) conforming to an SDC profile (https://hl7.org/fhir/uv/sdc/), with its canonical url and version.

renderedOn.description: How the person's device shows it. The form filler renders; this says what the person saw.

language.description: BCP 47 tag of the language shown.

offline.description: True when the device had no connection: the result is queued and synchronised later.

launchContext.description: The SDC launchContext values the form declares (https://hl7.org/fhir/uv/sdc/StructureDefinition-sdc-questionnaire-launchContext.html), each a name and the resource bound to it.

prepopulated.description: Answers filled in before the person saw the form (SDC $populate or the device): proposals the person confirms or corrects.
